lancer.name: T-65 X-wing
lancer.abilityText: After another friendly ship at range 0-3 is destroyed, you may perform a focus or boost action.

bulwark.name: BTL-A4 Y-wing
bulwark.abilityText: After another friendly ship at range 0-3 is destroyed, you may perform a focus or boost action.

dart.name: TIE/ln Fighter
dart.abilityText: At the end of the End Phase, if there is another friendly TIE/ln Fighter at range 0-1, you may remove 1 stress token.

stiletto.name: TIE Advanced x1
stiletto.abilityText: While you perform a primary attack against a defender you have locked, roll 1 additional attack die and change 1 hit result to a crit result.

lancer-shepherd.name: Garven Dreis
lancer-shepherd.caption: Red Leader
lancer-shepherd.text: After you spend a focus token, you may choose 1 friendly ship at range 1-3. That ship gains 1 focus token.

lancer-prodigy.name: Luke Skywalker
lancer-prodigy.caption: Red Five
lancer-prodigy.text: After you become the defender (before dice are rolled), you may recover 1 force.

lancer-deadeye.name: Wedge Antilles
lancer-deadeye.caption: Red Two
lancer-deadeye.text: While you perform an attack, the defender rolls 1 fewer defense die.

lancer-prodigy-sl.name: Luke Skywalker
lancer-prodigy-sl.caption: Red Five
lancer-prodigy-sl.text: After you are declared as the defender during an attack, you may recover 1 force.

bulwark-overseer.name: Horton Salm
bulwark-overseer.caption: Gray Leader
bulwark-overseer.text: While you perform an attack, you may reroll 1 attack die for each other friendly ship at range 0-1 of the defender.

bulwark-bulldog.name: Norra Wexley
bulwark-bulldog.caption: Gold Nine
bulwark-bulldog.text: While you defend, if there is an enemy ship at range 0-1, add 1 evade result to your dice results.

dart-nightowl.name: “Night Beast”
dart-nightowl.caption: Obsidian Two
dart-nightowl.text: After you fully execute a blue maneuver, you may perform a focus action.

dart-baron.name: Valen Rudor
dart-baron.caption: Braggadocious Baron
dart-baron.text: After a friendly ship at range 0-1 defends (after damage is resolved, if any), you may perform an action.

dart-vulture.name: Gideon Hask
dart-vulture.caption: Inferno Two
dart-vulture.text: While you perform an attack against a damaged defender, roll 1 additional attack die.

dart-brawler.name: “Mauler” Mithel
dart-brawler.caption: Black Two
dart-brawler.text: While you perform an attack at attack range 1, roll 1 additional attack die.

dart-needle.name: “Scourge” Skutu
dart-needle.caption: Seasoned Veteran
dart-needle.text: While you perform an attack against a defender in your bullseye arc, roll 1 additional attack die.

dart-packleader.name: “Howlrunner”
dart-packleader.caption: Obsidian Leader
dart-packleader.text: While a friendly ship at range 0-1 performs a primary attack, that ship may reroll 1 attack die.

stiletto-comet.name: Juno Eclipse
stiletto-comet.caption: Corulag's Finest
stiletto-comet.text: After you perform an action, you may perform a red boost action.

stiletto-warlord.name: Darth Vader
stiletto-warlord.caption: Black Leader
stiletto-warlord.text: After you perform an action, you may spend 1 force to perform an action.

stiletto-warlord-sl.name: Darth Vader
stiletto-warlord-sl.caption: Black Leader
stiletto-warlord-sl.text: After you perform an action, you may spend 1 force to perform an action.

heavy-torpedoes.name: Proton Torpedoes
heavy-torpedoes.text: Attack (lock): Spend 1 charge. Change 1 hit result to a crit result.

ion-missiles.name: Ion Missiles
ion-missiles.text: Attack (lock): Spend 1 charge. If this attack hits, spend 1 hit or crit result to cause the defender to suffer 1 hit damage. All remaining hit/crit results inflict ion tokens instead of damage.

ion-turret.name: Ion Cannon Turret
ion-turret.text: Attack: If this attack hits, spend 1 hit or crit result to cause the defender to suffer 1 hit damage. All remaining hit/crit results inflict ion tokens instead of damage.

afterburners.name: Afterburners
afterburners.text: After you fully execute a speed 3-5 maneuver, you may spend 1 charge to perform a boost action, even while stressed.

elusive.name: Elusive
elusive.text: While you defend, you may spend 1 charge to reroll 1 defense die. After you fully execute a red maneuver, recover 1 charge.

predator.name: Predator
predator.text: While you perform a primary attack, if the defender is in your bullseye arc, you may reroll 1 attack die.

marksmanship.name: Marksmanship
marksmanship.text: While you perform an attack, if the defender is in your bullseye arc, you may change 1 hit result to a crit result.

crack-shot.name: Crack Shot
crack-shot.text: While you perform a primary attack, if the defender is in your bullseye arc, before the Neutralize Results step, you may spend 1 charge to cancel 1 evade result.

outmaneuver.name: Outmaneuver
outmaneuver.text: While you perform a front arc attack, if you are not in the defender's firing arc, the defender rolls 1 fewer defense die.

fire-control.name: Fire-Control System
fire-control.text: While you perform an attack, if you have a lock on the defender, you may reroll 1 attack die. If you do, you cannot spend your lock during this attack.

instinctive-aim.name: Instinctive Aim
instinctive-aim.text: While you perform a special attack, you may spend 1 force to ignore the focus or lock requirement.

evasive-insight.name: Brilliant Evasion
evasive-insight.text: While you defend, if you are not in the attacker's bullseye arc, you may spend 1 force to change 2 of your focus results to evade results.

wrath.name: Hate
wrath.text: After you suffer 1 or more damage, recover that many force.

field-droid.name: R2 Astromech
field-droid.text: After you reveal your dial, you may spend 1 charge and gain 1 disarm token to recover 1 shield.

ace-droid.name: R2-D2
ace-droid.text: After you reveal your dial, you may spend 1 charge and gain 1 disarm token to recover 1 shield.

salvage-droid.name: R5 Astromech
salvage-droid.text: Action: Spend 1 charge to repair 1 facedown damage card. Action: Repair 1 faceup Ship damage card.
